fightSong.title: Smoke in the Air
fightSong.lyrics: When the fountains run red and gold / And the smoke rolls over Arrowhead's soul / We light the fire, we tend the flame / Fountains up, we play the game!
fightSong.chant: LOW AND SLOW! LOW AND SLOW!

stadium.name: The Smokehouse
stadium.tradition: The Pitmaster's Torch — local BBQ legend lights 12-foot smoker-fountain pre-game. Winner gets gold spatula on concourse wall. 47 spatulas currently.

fanCulture.description: Season ticket holders are 'Pitmasters' (10+ years) or 'Apprentices'. After every TD, PA plays 3-second sizzle. Fans bring spray bottles labeled 'APPLE JUICE' and mist air on 3rd downs. Booing is 'bad smoke' — they chant 'NEEDS MORE TIME' instead.
fanCulture.tailgate: 8 hours early, competitive smoking. Judged by former players.

rivalries.name: The Cookout
rivalries.narrative: The Sauce vs The Suit. Denver fans in Patagonia vests talking cap space; KC fans in sauce-stained aprons talking feel.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: TOUCHDOWN... and the smoke rises in KANSAS CITY!

cityFlavor: 200+ fountains, jazz, and smoke. BBQ isn't food here, it's religion with denominations (sweet, spicy, vinegar).
